description: `CancelToken` is the read-only side of cooperative cancellation. `CancelTokenSource` owns the authority to request cancellation:

CancelToken.luau.description: Provides a read-only signal for cooperative cancellation. Cancellation authority belongs to the executor or a [CancelTokenSource]. Public entry points include `CancelToken.new`, `CancelToken.isCancelToken`, `CancelToken.fromMaid`, `CancelToken.fromSeconds`, `CancelToken.ErrorIfCancelled`, `CancelToken.IsCancelled`, `CancelToken.GetReason`.

CancelTokenSource.luau.description: Owns cancellation authority for a read-only [CancelToken]. Public entry points include `CancelTokenSource.new`, `CancelTokenSource.GetToken`, `CancelTokenSource.Cancel`, `CancelTokenSource.IsCancelled`, `CancelTokenSource.Destroy`.
